name: boomi-companion
description: Claude Code plugins for building, operating, and automating on the Boomi integration platform.

plugins.name: bc-integration
plugins.description: Design, script, and troubleshoot Boomi integration processes: process design, Groovy/JavaScript Data Process scripting, EDI/profile mapping, and AtomSphere API automation.

plugins.name: bc-marketplace
plugins.description: Search and evaluate prebuilt Boomi Marketplace recipes and connectors before building an integration from scratch.

plugins.name: bc-datahub
plugins.description: Operational support for Boomi Data Hub: model design, match/merge rules, golden record governance, and sourcing/publishing integrations.

plugins.name: bc-bdi
plugins.description: Operational support for Boomi Data Integration: batch/ETL pipelines, database connectors, data lake and warehouse loads.

plugins.name: bc-agentstudio
plugins.description: Operational support for Boomi Agentstudio: designing agents, tools, and knowledge bases, and wiring agents into Boomi processes.
